name: Dr. Wahn Khang
title: Board-certified periodontist and implant surgeon · Founder, Perio Implant Center, Reston, Virginia
bio:
Dr. Wahn Khang has spent three decades in clinical practice. As founder and director of the Perio Implant Center in Reston, Virginia, he focuses on advanced periodontal therapy, bone grafting and complex dental implant surgery.
He has taught more than 1,000 dental residents and practicing dentists. He is on the faculty of the Harvard School of Dental Medicine and Tufts University School of Dental Medicine, and is an associate professor at the University of Maryland School of Dentistry, where he was Chief Resident during his periodontology residency.
Dr. Khang lectures nationally and internationally and has published widely on periodontics and implantology.
